gen-gf-oxanium-fs-amulya: Oxanium stands tall, its big lowercase drawn in unbroken single-width lines. Amulya, a plain sans with generous curve gaps, sits lower in height and gives the heading room to be loud.
gen-gf-oxanium-fs-chillax: Oxanium is all commanding structure, with tall lowercase and monoline strokes whose curves end in clear daylight. Chillax does the opposite job, unwinding in casual, spaghetti-like lines that feel relaxed.
gen-gf-oxanium-fs-plein: Plein is a clean, reliable plain sans, with a clear channel leading into each round letter. Oxanium brings rounded-rod, single-weight swagger and a noticeably taller lowercase to the mix.
gen-gf-oxanium-fs-synonym: Commanding up top, dependable underneath. Oxanium earns its keep big and short, its tall lowercase and monoline strokes standing out, while Synonym keeps a plain stripe of constant ink.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-aclonica: Aclonica stretches out, wide-spaced and deep through the lowercase midsection. Oxanium, whose lowercase a has no thin hairline strokes, sets its unbroken monoline command against the restrained thick-thin rhythm of the body.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-allerta: Fixed-pen strokes and a tall lowercase make Oxanium look built, not drawn. Allerta, a sans with wide, loose tracking and a prominent x-height, would read in an easy, spread-out way over many lines.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-anaheim: Commanding and distinctive, Oxanium runs curves and stems in lockstep. Anaheim does the friendlier work, with rounded, side-open forms and a dense huddle of lowercase that fills the line like capitals.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-cal-sans: Tall lowercase, unbroken monoline strokes: that is the look of Oxanium. Cal Sans, modern and approachable with one stroke width throughout and short ascenders, would read in a friendly tall-bodied rhythm line after line.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-carlito: Big, commanding lowercase: Oxanium draws it in contrast-free strokes from stem to terminal, tall and unmistakable. Carlito, a tightly spaced sans, would read like thread wound on a spool.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-courier-prime: A high x-height makes the lowercase of Oxanium look big, drawn in monoline strokes whose curves end in daylight. Courier Prime, a monospace, adds the structured line of a technical drafting pen.
